title: Frontend route-level runtime smoke hardening
acceptance_criteria: Browser smoke defaults include high-risk routing, infrastructure, multicast, and DHCP routes that previously regressed.
Smoke defaults use http://localhost:3000 to avoid origin/cookie false negatives.
Runtime smoke probes a critical route set and fails on unexpected statuses.
Frontend validation flow (build, restart vm-ui, smoke:runtime, smoke:ui) passes end-to-end.
assumptions: Playwright shared libraries are available on this host via LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
vm-ui tmux session is the canonical runtime process for frontend validation.

tasks.notes: Expanded default route coverage and normalized smoke origin to localhost.
Ran typecheck, build, restarted vm-ui, and executed runtime + browser smoke successfully.
Validated that browser smoke catches client-side crashes and now covers user-reported regression routes.
Continue one-function-at-a-time parity slices, reusing the hardened runtime gate before every handoff.
Manual review complete for scope; no API contract changes.
